mapper.select: select storage.PRJ_ID as prjId,a.NAME as prjName, storage.STAGE_ID as stageId,e.NAME as stageName, storage.SUB_ITEM_ID as subItemId,b.NAME as subItemName, storage.PROFESSION_ID as professionId,f.NAME as professionName, storage.ID as fId,storage.PARENT_ID as fParentId,storage.NAME as fName,storage.TYPE as fType from BIZ_CAD_STORAGE storage left join BIZ_CAD_PROJECT a on a.ID = storage.PRJ_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_SUB_ITEM b on b.ID = storage.SUB_ITEM_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_STAGE e on e.ID = storage.STAGE_ID LEFT JOIN BIZ_CAD_PROFESSION f on f.ID = storage.PROFESSION_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
